T: A cock in a frock on a rock. And a picnic.
D: Three drag performers drive a bus from Sydney to Alice Springs for a show.
P: Serve the snacks when the bus pulls into Broken Hill.
S: Sausage mince with grated onion, carrot and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame seeds on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.

Shimmering cubes of blue, green and purple jelly set inside clear lemon jelly and cut into chunks, with a little edible glitter like raw opal. Make three 85g packets of blue, green and purple jelly with 250ml boiling water each, set in shallow trays for 2 hours and cut into small cubes. Soak 6 gelatine leaves, dissolve in 500ml hot lemonade with 2 tbsp lemon juice and cool. Scatter the cubes into a lined 20cm tin, pour over the clear jelly and set 3 hours. Cut into chunks and dust with edible glitter.

Warm golden bush damper with a crusty top, torn open at the table with cold butter and a good pour of golden syrup. Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt, add 300ml milk and mix to a soft dough. Shape a round, cut a cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.
M: Bob the mechanic who helps them out on the road

Thick beef snags grilled slowly, rosemary and garlic lamb chops, fried onions and a tomato, cucumber and red onion salad, served on the tailgate. Marinate 8 lamb chops in olive oil, rosemary, 2 crushed garlic cloves and lemon zest for 30 minutes. Cook 8 thick beef sausages over medium coals for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate with oil until soft and golden. Grill the chops 3 minutes a side. Toss 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 cucumber and half a red onion with oil, vinegar and salt. Serve with bread and sauce.

Kangaroo fillet marinated in pepperberry, garlic and oil, seared hard to rare, rested, sliced, with a quandong or plum sauce and roast sweet potato.
W: Egg whites whisked with caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, shaped into a round, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, passionfruit and strawberries.
K: the show at Alice Springs, finally on stage

Fresh raspberry and peach purée topped with chilled sparkling rosé in flutes, a single raspberry dropped in each glass. Blend 150g raspberries with 1 ripe peach (or 200g tinned peaches, drained) and 1 tbsp sugar syrup until smooth, then strain. Spoon 30ml purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with 150ml cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.

s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion, a grated carrot and herbs. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Cut into 16 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.

m.note: they finally make it to Alice
m.how: Rub 800g kangaroo fillet with 1 tsp ground pepperberry, garlic and oil. Roast 800g sweet potato wedges at 200C for 35 minutes. Sear the fillet hard to rare, rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with warmed plum sauce.

w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 3 passionfruit and 250g strawberries.
